div.p: ADR-014 (chosen) — atomic db.batch() write + post-commit inngest.send, with a 30s cron sweep as the durable backstop

g.text: Neon Postgres — atomic db.batch() · one BEGIN…COMMIT (adr017)
Side effects — a new subscriber is a new Inngest fn
durable workers · idempotency key = outbox row id
2 · post-commit inngest.send (best-effort) · set processed_at on ok
